title: Multi-Window Support — Review Map
description: Review map for the multi-window change (commit 5841ad3). Each `walkingcode open` now spawns an independent Electron process, so multiple arch files can be open at once. Click each node to jump to the exact code.

meta.reviewTarget: commit 5841ad3 feat: allow multiple arch files open simultaneously (multi-process)

layers.name: Single-Instance Lock Removal
layers.description: The Electron main process no longer holds a global lock — each open spawns its own process.

modules.name: index.ts — startup
modules.description: Removed requestSingleInstanceLock + second-instance handler. The app now goes straight to whenReady → initSession → createWindow. window-all-closed quits unconditionally (each process owns one window).

elements.name: no single-instance lock
elements.description: The comment documents the design: each open spawns its own process; sessions are process-private so no routing is needed.

elements.name: window-all-closed → quit
elements.description: Now quits unconditionally (removed the darwin exception) — with no single-instance lock, there's no reason to keep the process alive on macOS.

layers.name: Multi-PID Tracking
layers.description: The CLI runtime switched from one PID file to a pids/ directory with one file per running process.

modules.name: runtime.ts — PID store
modules.description: Replaced the single `pid` file with a `pids/` directory. Each process writes a file named by its PID; readLivePids() lists all alive processes and reaps stale entries.

elements.name: writePid(pid, archFile)
elements.description: Writes pids/<pid> containing the arch file path; also updates the advisory arch-file record.

elements.name: readLivePids()
elements.description: Scans pids/, returns alive PidRecords, and cleans up dead entries as a side effect.

elements.name: clearAllPids()
elements.description: Removes every PID file — used by close and open --force.

layers.name: CLI Commands
layers.description: open no longer refuses; close stops every instance.

modules.name: open.ts — allow multi-open
modules.description: Removed the 'already running → exit(1)' guard. Every open spawns a new process and records its PID. --force now stops ALL instances first.

elements.name: --force stops all
elements.description: Reads readLivePids(), kills each, then clearAllPids() before spawning.

elements.name: spawn + writePid
elements.description: Each open spawns its own electron process and records the PID — no guard, no refusal.

modules.name: close.ts — stop all instances
modules.description: Iterates readLivePids(), SIGTERMs each, escalates to SIGKILL with --force, then clears all records.

elements.name: iterate + kill loop
elements.description: For each live PID: SIGTERM, wait 2s, optionally SIGKILL, then clearPid.

edges.label: no lock → multiple spawns
edges.description: Removing the lock is what allows open to spawn multiple processes.

edges.label: writePid / readLivePids
edges.description: open writes a per-process PID; uses readLivePids for --force.

edges.label: readLivePids / clearAllPids
edges.description: close reads all live PIDs to stop them.

edges.label: spawns electron
edges.description: open spawns electron which runs the no-lock startup in index.ts.
